today.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

days_ahead.description: Days ahead to consider 'due soon' for slipping followups. Default 7.

lookback_days.description: Days back that define 'recent engagement' for the health scan. Default 45.

focus_account_id.description: Optional: scope analysis to one account id.

max_recommendations.description: Cap on the recommendations list. Default 8.

create_followup_tasks.description: If true, emit a `tasks` row per recommendation (default true; never sends anything).
